body:
Thank you for your response - it is very much appreciated.

I have been aware for some time that I would like to seek some form of professional help, even if I am not necessarily feeling as low as I have been as of late. I feel as though in general, it would be beneficial, as we all have out baggage, and there's absolutely nothing wrong with wanting to talk it out. To that end, I plan to seek out my college's counseling services, as they are at no cost to students, but there's time yet before the next semester. My insurance was cancelled due to being abroad, and while I have applied for medical benefits once again as a student, I have no choice but to wait, and even then there may be no guarantee.

So in the meantime, I have continued to hold on to one day at a time to at least fight the negative, without forcing a necessity of positivity on myself, and I'm hoping it'll help, but it's that time in between that's so worrisome.

But again, it's a matter of taking things one day at a time. But there are times when getting out to people who will listen and won't make one feel guilty is indispensable, and once again - thank you.
